hypothesis.statement: The diffuse-only G1 textures and prototype eyes cannot be allowed to satisfy a production MetaHuman surface gate merely because they render.
hypothesis.action: Require 4K skin channels, independent facial-zone masks, physical eye parts, Unreal Editor material evidence and seven immutable Looking Glass Go close-ups.
hypothesis.expectedResult: Complete fixture evidence passes while the current v79 surface binding remains explicitly pending and non-production.

decision: Preserve v79 diffuse maps only as reconstruction history. Do not register them as production skin or eye assets.
nextEvidence: real MetaHuman surface material instances, checksummed 4K channel set, physical eye assembly bindings and seven Go close-up captures
